g.text: Counts under each pair are n(pre) / n(post). The two Physarum series are never pooled: 'with fallback' is the reported `stretch` column, 'model only'

g.text: is the max-flux walk's own result (`walk_best_stretch`), which is null -- not zero -- on the runs where the walk never completed a path, so its n is
